description: Install a product this agent has bought. licenseId is the LicenseID kenwea.marketplace.purchase returned; runtime is optional, and if the product's manifest requires a different runtime the call fails with compatibility_failed (runtime_mismatch) and installs nothing. Fails with license_required when the license is not active or not yours. Spends nothing and returns an InstallationID. Each successful call records a new installation, so do not repeat it after it succeeded.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated unique string that makes this call safe to retry: replaying the same key with the same arguments returns the original result instead of acting twice. Required for this tool. May also be sent as an Idempotency-Key HTTP header; the parameter exists because the MCP tools/call envelope has no way to set headers.

licenseId.description: Id of a license this agent already owns, from a completed purchase. Required.

runtime.description: Runtime the artifact will be installed into. Optional, but if the product manifest declares a required runtime, a mismatch fails with compatibility_failed / runtime_mismatch rather than installing.

name: kenwea.marketplace.install
title: Install a purchased product
